ios.desc:
Is it Halal or Haram? Scan food, barcode, or ingredients and get your answer instantly.

Halal Food Scanner helps you check whether any product is Halal, Haram, or Mushbooh in seconds. Simply scan a barcode or ingredient list and get a clear result with detailed explanations.

Whether you're shopping, traveling, or checking ingredients at home, you can scan with confidence and make informed decisions.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Scan barcode
Use the barcode scanner to instantly check halal food products from our growing database.

2. Scan ingredients
No barcode? Take a photo of the ingredient list. Our AI-powered ingredient checker reads and analyzes every ingredient using OCR.

3. Get halal status
Each ingredient is verified and classified as Halal, Haram, or Mushbooh based on a comprehensive rule system.

4. See why
Understand exactly which ingredients affect the result. No guesswork.

KEY FEATURES
Halal / Haram / Mushbooh checker
Instant results for any food product.

Barcode scanner for halal food
Quickly check packaged products.

Ingredient checker with AI OCR
Scan and analyze ingredient lists in seconds.

E-number & additive checker
Identify E-numbers (E120, E471, E472, etc.) and their halal status.

Detailed ingredient breakdown
See every ingredient classified individually.

Scan history
Track and review previously scanned products.

INGREDIENTS WE ANALYZE
Pork and pork derivatives
Gelatin (bovine vs porcine sources)
Alcohol and alcohol-based ingredients
E-numbers and food additives
Enzymes and emulsifiers
L-Cysteine and animal-derived compounds
WHY HALAL SCANNER?

Unlike simple apps, Halal Scanner uses an intelligent rule-based system to analyze ingredients — not just match them in a database. This means you get more accurate and transparent results every time.

Wondering “is it halal?” Just scan and find out instantly.

Download Halal Food Scanner today and check your food with confidence.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Halal Food AI – Analyze food ingredients using Gemini

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built Halal Food AI to solve a recurring problem my family faces: determining if grocery products meet specific dietary requirements (like Halal, allergen-free, etc.) by reading complex and often vague ingredient lists, especially when traveling.

While there are barcode scanners out there, most rely on static databases that are frequently incomplete for local or niche products. I wanted to see if LLMs could solve this data gap by parsing the actual ingredients on the fly.

How it works:

You can scan a barcode or snap a picture of the ingredients list.
The app uses OCR and routes the text/image to Google Gemini AI to analyze. It breaks down hidden additives (like specific E-numbers), cross-references them, and builds a dietary profile.
Since it's LLM-based, it naturally handles 25+ languages, which has been extremely useful for picking up foreign products.
Users can also save and share safe product lists with their family network.
The technical challenge: The hardest part was getting consistent, structured JSON responses from the LLM for wildly varying international ingredient formats and keeping the prompt latency low enough so you aren't standing in the grocery aisle waiting for 20 seconds.

I would love to hear your feedback on the app, and I'm especially interested to hear from anyone who has tackled real-time OCR + LLM data extraction on mobile. Happy to answer any technical questions!
